rules: No Inter or standard Sans for headings.
Overlines must be uppercase and wide (tracking-[0.2em]).
Line Height: Tight (leading-none) for headers, Loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
Hierarchy Gap Rule: The jump between a heading and its subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Mode B: Control Room Grid. Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Override stretch behavior on grid with align-items: start where needed.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_grid: Mode A: Tetris Grid. Asymmetric. Wide gaps (gap-8).
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding for standard components, but dashboard data-heavy widgets can use tighter spacing. Always wrap grid items properly.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-sm (2px to 4px max) to maintain a technical, authoritative Swiss look. Avoid heavy pill-shaped buttons.

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Grid Borders: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and slight shadow if interactive.
surface_strategies.headers: Solid background with a hard bottom border for dashboard. Crystal glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) for marketing page sticky nav.
surface_strategies.mobile_tech_view: Large touch targets (h-12 or p-4), high-contrast borders separating list items. Focus on 'Clock In/Out' and 'Status Update' via stark color blocks.

components.buttons: High contrast. Solid background for primary. 1px border for secondary. Add 'hover:bg-opacity-90' or lighter hue for hover state.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. Square or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). 1px border. High contrast focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-700).
components.charts: Shadcn charts or Recharts. Sharp lines, clear data points. Tooltips must have 1px border.
components.calendar: Drag and drop capability, distinct color markers using primary (Blue) and accent (Red) for status. Use a dense but legible grid.

image_urls.description: Marketing landing page hero image representing a sleek, modern command center / high-tech dashboard.
HVAC technician working, useful for features or about sections on the marketing page.
HVAC technician holding a tool, useful for mobile app view mockup or profile placeholder.
Plumber working on sink, useful for marketing page service list.

icons.instructions: Use Phosphor Icons (regular or duotone depending on section) for a clean, dense dashboard look. Install via yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Must explicitly set text color on hover. Increase contrast.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). Do not use transition-all.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include data-testid attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='submit-work-order-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for the Marketing Page to allow overlapping and asymmetry. Avoid restricting it with Shadcn structural components.
Use heavily customized Shadcn components for the Admin Dashboard.
Override default Shadcn rounding to rounded-sm (2px) or rounded-none to match the Swiss architecture theme.
Implement the Dashboard 'Jobs/Work Orders' Kanban or Table using dense UI practices, exposing data clearly without relying on large cards.
Mobile view for technicians must be extremely legible with large touch targets (min h-12 for primary actions) and focus on immediate task completion.
Implement data-testid attributes universally for testing.
For the calendar scheduling UI, ensure dense yet clear views with primary and accent color indicators.
Apply 'Swiss' layout rules: optical alignment, grid utilization, and negative space that frames data.
